LESSON: VIRTUES GENEROSITY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1: Virtues Generosity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Virtues Generosity. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should a Muslim practise generosity?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practise generosity as a virtue for character formation
2. appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: VIRTUES GENEROSITY
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Virtues Generosity helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: VIRTUES GENEROSITY
Study Virtues Generosity like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Practise generosity as a virtue for character formation

What this means
In this part you learn to practise generosity as a virtue for character formation. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise generosity as a virtue for character formation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Virtues Generosity” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise generosity as a virtue for character formation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Virtues Generosity in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Virtues Generosity is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Virtues Generosity” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: practise generosity as a virtue for character formation)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Virtues Generosity in your own words. (skill: appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Virtues Generosity to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: practise generosity as a virtue for character formation.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Virtues Generosity from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Virtues Generosity: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Virtues Generosity?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should a Muslim practise generosity?
2. When should a Muslim practise generosity?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Virtues Generosity means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: practise generosity as a virtue for character formation.
5. Be able to: appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of earning rewards from Allah.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
